question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
WITH delivered_counts AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS purchase_month,
    YEAR(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS order_year,
    COUNT(*) AS delivered_count
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND YEAR(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)),
           YEAR(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)),
           MONTH(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))
)
SELECT
  purchase_month,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2016 THEN delivered_count ELSE 0 END), 0)::INTEGER AS "2016",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2017 THEN delivered_count ELSE 0 END), 0)::INTEGER AS "2017",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2018 THEN delivered_count ELSE 0 END), 0)::INTEGER AS "2018"
FROM delivered_counts
GROUP BY purchase_month
ORDER BY purchase_month
